{{Quote|Care for some Deltron spice wine? This little gadget ferments it by microwaves and serves it up seasoned to any taste.|Augustus Tryll|<ref name="MSW24" />}}
A '''microwave fermentation device''' used [[microwave]]s to rapidly ferment [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic beverages]] such as [[Deltron spice wine]]. It emitted microwaves as a by-product, which could be used to track the device by those who knew what they were looking for. It was a luxury item during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One was used by [[Augustus Tryll]].<ref name="MSW24" />
